chapter.verse: Ka Pasian, ka Pasian aw, bang hangin kei hong nusia na hi hiam? Keimah nong huh nading kong thumna panin bang hangin gamla om na hi hiam?
Ka Pasian aw, sun-in ka kiko a, ahih hangin nong dawng kei hi; zan-in ka kiko a, ahih hangin lungsim nopna ka mu kei hi.
Ahih hangin nang Siangtho Pa na hi a, Israelte’ pahtawinate tungah na tu hi.
Ka pate un nangmah hong muang hi; amaute in hong muang uh a, nangmah in amaute na honkhia hi.
Nang tungah amaute in hong ko uh a, amaute kihonkhia hi; nangmah hong muang uh a, guaksuak lo uh hi.
Ahih hangin keimah in lungno khat bang ka hi lel a, mi ka hi kei hi; mite’ ko, mite’ simmawh ka hi hi.
Hong mu khempeuh in kei hong zahko-in, hong mukpik san uh a, a lu hong peisan uh hi.
“ Topa tungah amah in ama thu ap hi; amah honkhia sak un, amah deih ahih manin hon ta hen!” hong cihsan uh hi.
Ahih hangin nang in gilsung panin kei hong suaksakpa na hi hi; ka nu’ ang sungah muanhuai-in keimah nong kem hi.
Ka suah-a kipan nangma tungah kong tung a, ka nu in hong paai lai-a kipan keima Pasian na hi hi.
Haksatna nai ahih manin kei tawh kigamla om kei in, hong huh ding kuamah dang om lo hi.
Bawngtal tampi in kei hong umcih a, Bashan gam bawngtal hatte in kei hong umcih uh hi;
humpinelkai hawk leh sabawh nuam bangin amaute in kei hong kamkat beba uh hi.
Tui bangin kei hong kibua khia a, ka guh ka tang khempeuh kilawi khin hi; ka lungtang khuainun bang a, ka awm sungah tui suak hi;
ka thahatna in leibeel phel bangin keu a, ka leii zong toncip hi; nangmah in sihna leivui sungah kei nong koih hi.
Hi hi, ka kim-ah uite om a, siatna bawl mihon khat in hong umcih hi; ka khut ka khete sunlet zo uh hi—
Ka guh khempeuh ka sim thei hi—amaute in sal gega-in kei hong en uh hi;
amaute in amau lakah ka puante hawm uh a, ka puan hawm nadingin lai-ai saan uh hi.
Ahih hangin, Topa aw, gamla om ke’n! Keimah hong huhpa aw, huh dingin hong manlang ta’n!
Namsau panin keimah hong hon in la, ui’ thahatna panin ka nuntakna hong hon in.
Humpinelkai kam panin keimah hong hon in la, gamsialte’ ki panin a cimawh keimah hong hon in.
Ka u ka naute tungah nangma min ka gen ding a, mihon kikhopna laizangah nangmah kong phat ding hi:
Topa a zahtak note in amah phat un! Jakob tapate khempeuh aw, amah minthangsak un, Israel tapate khempeuh aw, amah lamdangsakna tawh om un!
Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in a thuak mi’ gimna simmawh lo, kih bawl lo hi; ama kiang panin a mai seel lo a, ama tungah a koh ciangin, amah in za hi.
Mi honpite lakah nang kong phat nading na piangsak a, nang a hong zahtakte mai-ah ka thuciamna ka hong pia ding hi.
Gimna thuakte in kham takin ne ding uh a, amah a zongte in Topa phat ding uh hi. A lungsim uh nuam tawntung ta hen!
Leimong khempeuh in phawkin Topa ’ lamah kihei ding uh a, minamte’ innkuan khempeuh in ama mai-ah bia ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ukna in Topa aa hi a, minamte tungah amah in uk hi.
Hi hi, leitung kiphatsakna khempeuh ama mai-ah kunsuk ding hi; leivui-a paisuk khempeuh leh a kikem tawm thei lote ama mai-ah kun ding uh hi.
Suan-le-khakte in ama na sem ding uh hi; mite in hong piang ding mihonte tungah Topa ’ thu gen ding uh a,
a suak nai lo mite tungah ama sepsa, hotkhiatna gen ding uh hi.
